image_description: A group of people dressed in elaborate pink and blue costumes with headdresses are dancing around a central wooden pole. The pole is decorated with long, colorful ribbons (streamers) extending from the top to the dancers' hands. The setting appears to be an outdoor festival on a gravel or dirt surface with hills in the background.

The distant hills and horizon line have a slight painterly smear and lack sharp geometric definition, though this is less severe than the foreground artifacts.
